command: Human HSPA13 localizes to the nucleus, plasma membrane or cytosol. Assess each independently using primary evidence, isoforms/constructs and physiological conditions. Reconcile ER-luminal proximity-labeling evidence with reported NKCC2 cytoplasmic-tail interaction and examine whether any secondary pool was actually demonstrated. A main ER residence or secretory-pathway role does not establish exclusivity. The existing protein-folding report is related but does not adjudicate these localization claims.
